notes:
The Hero Index was missing heroes.

An account that names several heroes the same only ever showed one of each, and up to a quarter of every sweep never reached the table. They are all there now — the full list fills in on the next Hero Index sweep.

Ranks read correctly again, and the Hero Index finally has its own Clear button; the old "Heroes" one only ever cleared your own accounts.

Also: choosing a Specific Exe no longer shows a false warning about the bot folder.

Nothing you need to do after updating.
